messages.en: How was this Seoul concert!!
I was actually more nervous than the previous Seoul concert…
Because I was revealing my blonde hair.

messages.ko: 내 성격에 얼마나 입이 근질 했을지
messages.en: Knowing my personality, you can imagine how badly I wanted to spoil it.
I kept dropping so many hints.

messages.ko: 나 이미 금발이야 말하지 못하는게 얼마나 답답했을지 예상이 돼!!!???
messages.en: Can you imagine how frustrating it was not being able to say, 'I'm already blonde!!!'?
ㅎㅎ
I'm so, so relieved that you all said it looks pretty.

messages.ko: 웨이브랑 같이 놀고 행복한 마음만 얻어가는것같아서 너무 고마워
messages.en: Thank you so much. I feel like I only took home happy memories from spending time with WAV.
After the first concert, I wasn't even tired.
I was just so excited for the second day's concert.
It was so, so much fun.

messages.ko: 항상 우리곁에 내 곁에 있어줘서 너무 고마워….😘
messages.en: Thank you so much for always being by our side, and by my side…. 😘
How was the concert~?
My hair color now
is the final color.
But since I already bleached it this much,
I might try some other colors too?
"Nick Hayeon."

messages.ko: 사진 더 많이 찍었으니까 천천히 다 보여쥴게ㅔ
messages.en: I took a lot more photos, so I'll show them to you little by little.
After working hard at today's concert,
I went out to eat beef with my family.
My older brother, my cousin, and my younger sibling came.
They all came.
We had a really satisfying meal.
The bill came to about 150,000 won.
I paid for it.
How's that?
I even told them to remember that I treated them.
I even told them to record a video so they wouldn't forget ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
When I make even more money,
I'll buy everything for WAV too.
Then my wallet would have 0 won left, right?
But I was really happy yesterday and today.
It's all thanks to you…
I truly mean it.
I think it probably showed on stage how happy I was.
I was also really happy that I got to show Harureong again.
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 온 사람들 2시간동안 엉댕이 아팠을텐데 참고 앉아있어줘서 고맙구~
messages.en: To everyone who came, your butts probably hurt after sitting for two hours, so thank you for staying with me~

messages.ko: 온라인으로 본사람들은 나의 금발 미모보고 2일동안 심장아팠을텐데 참아줘서 고맙구
messages.en: And to everyone who watched online, your hearts probably hurt for two days because of my blonde beauty, so thank you for enduring that too.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I think I'll be able to fall asleep happily tonight.
Sleep well.
Haranghae~ ❤️
